_readme: The highest UNGRADED values in Pokemon, from pricecharting.com.
Written by scripts/sync-raw-top.mjs from the pages sync-graded-top.mjs
already cached. NO NETWORK: see that script's header before adding one.
WHAT THE NUMBER IS. PriceCharting's Ungraded column: a price guide value
for a loose, ungraded copy, computed by their algorithm from completed
eBay sales and their own marketplace. It is NOT a marketplace's market
price, NOT a live listing and NOT an auction result, and no page may
describe it as any of those.
EVERY LANGUAGE, ON PURPOSE. PriceCharting's Pokemon catalogue is not split
by language, and this ranking is not either. Half the top 100 is Japanese.
The argument is in the header of scripts/build-top100.mjs.
A SNAPSHOT. `checked` is the day the crawl read these pages, borrowed from
data/top-graded.json because they are the same crawl. Every row carries
the url it came from and the page prints both.
NOTHING HERE IS PUBLISHABLE UNTIL verify-raw-top.mjs HAS RUN. The td ids
on a product page mean different grades than the ones on a listing page,
so a single read cannot be trusted. See data/top-graded-PLAN.md, trap 4.

excluded.name: Latias & Latios GX #170
excluded.public: the guide value moved between the two reads, so we hold two correct readings of it rather than one
excluded.why: NOT a parse failure. The console listing was crawled on August 22, 2026 and the product page read the same morning, and PriceCharting's own "dollar change from last update" on that product page's Ungraded cell says the value rose by $382.78: 2,705.09 - 382.78 = 2,322.31, the listing figure, to the cent. The same row's other two columns agreed and both reconcile the same way (Grade 9 5,408.11 to 5,229.63 on a change of -178.48, PSA 10 16,090.00 to 16,400.00 on a change of +310.00). Across all 160 rows and all three price columns, 431 readings have a figure on both page types: 408 are identical to the cent and the other 23 all reconcile against the change PriceCharting itself reports, with none left over, so the column mapping is demonstrably right on every row. This card was excluded for the same reason on August 18, 2026 at rank 118 and its TCGplayer market price moved 32% in the same week, so it is a genuinely fast-moving row rather than a recurring parser fault. Two correctly read figures this far apart still give no basis for printing either one, so the row is excluded. It sits below the hundredth place either way.
